title: SMTP injection defense (check_no_crlf) is correct and must be kept
description: submission.rs:421-427, 516-525 — explicit CRLF check on every rcptTo and mailFrom email address before building the SMTP envelope. This prevents header injection (SMTP smuggling). A future contributor might remove it thinking 'the RFC doesn't require this in the JMAP layer' — the check is in the right place because the JMAP server owns the envelope construction.
